title: 1812: the worn paths and yards are bare of grass
items: Round the 1812 houses, shops and stables the trodden ground is now clear of standing grass for a few metres before it frays back into the prairie.
The worn trails and the cart road south from the fort lose the tufts down their middles; a light path keeps a few.
How far the trampling reaches is our reconstruction (Liberty L-t3339-worn-ground-1812).
